name: PicoClaw
description: Ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant written in Go that runs on very cheap hardware with under 10MB of RAM.
whatItDoes: Provides a personal assistant on small boards and low-cost devices as well as ordinary computers. It was inspired by nanobot and written from scratch rather than forked.
howItWorks: A Go program with a very small memory footprint calls a remote LLM. Install and quick-start steps are in sections of the README that were not captured here, so no commands are listed.
